title: SophisticatedStorage issue #630: Latest Update Broke Limited Barrels

text:
[issue by johnfromstatefarm]
Latest update broke my golden limited barrels. I can only place one upgrade in the slot and all my previous upgrades have disappeared on all barrels. Some of my barrels now have 1 of each item when I had thousands.

Not sure how else to really report this.

 ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8811ee8a-68c5-4146-9e6c-a140790f9a08)

1.21.1 Neoforge 
.1113 update

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
I just tried with an older version and upgrading to the newest still has limited barrels working properly. 
Have you got latest core as well? 
Are you seeing anything in log from when the world loaded?
And what versions of core / storage did you have before you updated to the latest?

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
Also this one is extremely odd because it looks like the barrel for some reason got its slots reset and I don't recall making a change anywhere close to that code recently, most definitely not in the latest version or a few before that. So it looks more like server when loading the world for some reason had some issues and didn't load the data properly. But I may be wrong hence why the ask for the specific previous versions so that I can try to retest with them and see if I can recreate.

[comment by johnfromstatefarm (none)]
You may be right about the server issue. I did recently try launching minecraft with less RAM to see if performance would improve, and it did get stuck on the loading world screen before I had to force close. Now I worry what else may have broke if that was the case... Regardless:

1. I am on the latest Sophisticated Core and all of your other mods. 
2. I was getting a ton of OpenGL errors, which seem to be really common and flood console, but nothing major I can recall. 
3. I'm a little busy today, but it was the version right before .1113 and before the latest Sophisticated Core that was released on the same day. I update my mods every day.

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
yeah if the server crashed while loading it may mean files were corrupted either before or during the loading (if it happens to also save some of the data) and then it's really unpredictable what may be wrong after. 
Just to be sure I have also retested upgrading instance from the version right before .1113 to .1113 and everything works correctly for me.

[comment by johnfromstatefarm (none)]
I'll just chalk it up to my world being corrupt, not sure. Nobody else has said anything, so it's probably fine.

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
sure, but please let me know if you encounter this or anything similar again
